comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
When can i use the function "Use stockpile" at the forge to craft item without the ingredients?

I know this function is avaliable at the Industrial Revolution ports when they are at industrial revolution status and ONLY if you're at the port of your nation. But i wonder if it's the same for Manchester since England already have it own industrial revolution port (Portsmouth) and Manchester is not England's territory, but only ally. And because the forge there is always avaliable, diferent from common IR ports.

I want to use this "Use stockpile" function because is the only way to rank the cannonsmith title up and saving sophia points, but i'm french and i never get the IR status at my nation. Wonder if it's possible to me to do it at Manchester.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
My sincere apologies. When I answered your question earlier under the Cannonsmith (Fracturing Explosive Shells) page, I regrettably neglected a key point: Manchester allows many similar functions to national IR Towns. However, Manchester also has a few differences, including the fact that it has no "Use Stockpile" function for players of any nation.

So I'm afraid that you must gather the required materials for each production attempt. (Certain recipes are nation IR Town specific and also do not appear at Manchester either, but that is a separate issue.) It should still be possible to max your Cannonsmith title, it will just require a bit more work as a result.

My apologies once again. Cheers, and I really hope you can complete your title ranking successfully.

comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
Thank you Guilder, you're awesome!
It worked!
Made some Volkan Cannons and raised my title rank!
